description: Independent reference synthetic-lethal reaction pairs for iIT341 (H. pylori, 554 reactions) among the 45 smallest single-viable reactions, from COBRApy double_reaction_deletion. A bounded double-deletion sweep on a second, larger, different-organism model, so Reprolith's synthetic_lethal_reactions is shown to generalize beyond the 95-reaction E. coli core — not just to reproduce one small network's epistasis.
